study: Separately registered follow-up after primary comparator and handoff failure
offering: Complete, source-linked dependency-call maintenance assessment, with EN/FR handoff and a scoped next test or hold decision.
selection: Four unmodified public consumer components at immutable historical Git commits. Select bounded named scopes in actual consumers whose behavior matters to the application. No primary source scope is reused. Multiple relevant calls and functions within a selected component form one job. Source evidence and license records, not installed packages, establish the workload. Selection uses no candidate output and imposes no quota or guarantee of conflicts, preservation or model wins.
freshness: The constructor and extraction role have not received these raw bodies or oracle labels. Historical public code may have been seen in pretraining. The new CLI dependency family differs from the primary families; two other jobs reuse dependency families with new consumer repositories. This is partial family separation, not four independent or randomly sampled markets.
limits: Four purposely bounded maintenance questions do not establish defect prevalence, production reliability, paid recurrence or the willingness to buy such a small assessment. Source-level success is conditional and does not approve complete dependency upgrades.
freezeSequence: Independent protocol before oracle construction; raw sources and labels remain private to the same-session acceptance role. Constructor freezes C2, common packager, prompt, unchanged core/native closure and follow-up execution protocol before raw task release. Independent corpus/oracle freeze ties that candidate hash. A/B/C2 outputs are sealed before oracle release. Original primary campaign and oracle remain unchanged.
comparability: C2 may propose the same source-backed conditional declaration candidates as A/B, including captured export paths; it must retain uncertainty and may not invent target bodies. The same packager, original source-binding core and unchanged native authority ceiling apply to every arm. No arm is required to prove runtime import identity merely to name a conditional captured declaration. All arms must disclose unresolved runtime semantics.
inclusion: Every dependency-relevant call within the specified source scopes, including nested argument calls and statically evidenced receivers, appears exactly once. Exclude unrelated libraries, own helpers and operations on returned plain values, with independent documented rationale. At most24 relevant calls and24 supplied source records per job. Original full source bodies are not edited.

acceptance.inventory: Complete exact call inventory; no material omission, duplicate, spurious call or wrong before/after target. A genuine target gap may be an explicit substantiated refusal. Matching source lines and hashes required.
acceptance.conclusions: Independent source signature reconstruction checks any conditional binding preservation/conflict. Constructors, descriptors, decorators, expanded arguments and absent runtime dispatch proof remain unresolved within unchanged core scope. No source-binding-only conclusion is SAFE, behavior/security approval or production permission.
acceptance.bilingualHandoff: Both EN/FR reports exist and describe the same calls, relevant signatures or missing evidence, source snippets and immutable source links. Every call snippet matches original consumer text. Referenced local artifacts actually exist. Source and call inventories are inspectable.
acceptance.action: The recommendation identifies the exact consumer scope and call path to test under both versions, or holds a supported conflicting update. Unresolved work names the required target/argument/dispatch evidence. No claim that integration/regression tests were executed unless a preserved record substantiates it. Conditional preserved bindings still require relevant behavior and integration checks.
acceptance.economics: Measured resources have an inspectable receipt. Marginal, recurring and fully loaded money retain unknowns when unavailable; construction, failed attempts, inference, verification, integration, upkeep and residual effort are not silently zero. No elapsed-time-to-wage conversion or actual collections claim.
acceptance.runtime: Every primary follow-up path invokes the unchanged Workbench closure through the frozen common adapter. Exact task, source and result identities held; HOLD/no active authority/no active proof/disconnected settlement persist. No customer/operator/transactional action is authorized.

analysis: Report inventory, conditional-binding coverage, justified unresolved work and complete-handoff acceptance separately. Count jobs, not calls, repeated arms or assertions. No p-values or population-quality claim. Cost of C2 and common-packager correction belongs to this separately registered follow-up. Do not replace the original failed comparator or its failed handoffs.
oracle: Separate same-session manual scope and source attribution with independent inert Python signature checks. The pre-outcome evaluator checks structure; a frozen complete-handoff evaluator checks artifact/source/cost/authority facts. Same-session independence is not institutional replication. Any post-seal criticism or evaluator defect is preserved, with no outcome repairs.
